issues.issue: Operating expenses paid from an SID sinking/bond fund are often paying/fiscal agent and bond fees, which the SID rule puts in debt service interest / debt interest and fees. The page doesn't say which, so general government is defensible but uncertain. The same applies to receipts-side disbursements[1] 'Other operating expenses' (Sinking/Bond column 85,340, p2).

Budget column prints '-' (zero) for Property tax relief and Homestead exemption (General p3, also detail[3], detail[10], detail[11] on p4), but these are recorded as null. Actual-column dashes elsewhere are recorded as 0, so the handling is inconsistent.
